reviewer: Codex, one qualitative pass; no independent second annotator
selection: q5-semantic-v1: per seed, sort by pre-marker whitespace-word count then question ID; divide 100 saved completions into four groups of 25; choose two smallest SHA256(q5-semantic-v1:{seed}:{idx}) values in each group; do not use correctness

roles.I: Interpretation: restating givens, assigning variables, or translating a relationship into an equation without solving it
roles.P: Plan: choosing an operation or subgoal before carrying it out
roles.C: Calculation: executing arithmetic, substitution, simplification, or a derivation
roles.S: Summary or conclusion within the pre-marker rationale
roles.V: Independent check of the solution rather than repeating the result

conventions: Label each nonempty pre-marker line with all applicable roles. Equation construction is I; solving is C. Brief task-restatements attached to arithmetic may be I+C. A line is a pure pre-calculation prefix only if it contains I/P and no C. These labels describe text functions, not hidden model cognition. Word positions are not model-token positions.
